messages:
zoe-cs: Quick alert  VerdantAI hit regional limits during a partner demo. Theyre requesting an urgent short-lived QPS increase + IP allowlist for EU and APAC while onboarding wraps up. Case 820333 opened.

mike-net: What are the specific targets and CIDR blocks? Which edges do they want?

zoe-cs: Case 820333 requests: EU -> 3600 qps (currently ~950), APAC -> 1300 qps (currently ~480). Window 30 hours starting now, then auto-revoke. Egress ranges: 34.198.0.0/16 and 15.204.32.0/19. They prefer eu-west and apac-sg edges.

aran-ops: We can do ephemeral L7 allowlist with TTL=108000s (30h) and tag entries 'cust:verdantai-820333'. If this persists well need ASN/peering info. Applying in ~5m.

jeff-eng: Route info? For the burst set max_concurrency=9, cap max_tokens=450, enable prefix cache and KV warmup with their demo prompts. Recommend runtime fallback to redwood/llama-2-13b-chat-q4 if 70b queueing exceeds 4%.

zoe-cs: Route: verdant-prod-chat -> redwood/llama-2-70b-chat-q4. Customer ok with 13b fallback. Also asked we log per-region percent errors during the window.

clara-sales: Renewal note: VerdantAI renewal in 19 days. This demo ties to expansion; please capture perf logs and any infra abnormalities in the case so AE can follow up.

infra-bot: Ticket 820333-ephemeral-allowlist created by zoe-cs. Assigned: mike-net. SLA: 3h.

mike-net: Implementing L7 rules now with header match to restrict to demo traffic where possible. Plan: add TTL=108000, map CIDRs to eu-west/apac-sg pools, tag 'ephemeral:verdant-820333'. Rolling apply ~3m.

aran-ops: After apply please run a curl smoke test and paste snippet to the case. Use our standard minimal check: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"route":"verdant-prod-chat","input":"ping","max_tokens":6}'
```

mike-net: Done  rules applied and tagged. Verified 200 from test IP 34.198.45.12 hitting eu-west. Auto-revoke scheduled for 2024-10-03T22:00:00Z.

jeff-eng: Ran a focused synthetic at a 600qps pilot slice: p50 82ms, p95 350ms, p99 680ms. Enabled KV warmup and prefix caching. No redispatch queueing observed. Will monitor p99 during full demo.

aran-ops: Pushed per-region error counters and request logs to case per customer ask. Also added an alert rule to notify the oncall if per-region 5xx > 1% for more than 5m.

zoe-cs: Notifying VerdantAI that the bump + allowlist are live and sending curl example. Scheduling a 20-min enablement check with their SRE at 2024-10-03T16:00:00Z. I'll capture demo feedback in the case.

clara-sales: Thanks team :clap: I flagged Renewal Watch on case 820333 and CC'd AE. Please add any follow-up notes after the demo.

mike-net: Logged smoke output and curl to the case. Rules will auto-cleanup.

zoe-cs: Closing loop with sales after the demo and will update case with any post-demo actions.
